summary: The PR adds a search endpoint to OrderService. One critical SQL injection risk and a missing null check were found; the rest are minor.

findings.title: SQL injection via string concatenation
findings.description: The search term is interpolated directly into the query string, allowing SQL injection.
findings.suggestion: Use parameterized queries or an ORM (e.g. EF Core) instead of string interpolation.

findings.title: Missing null check on request payload
findings.description: request.CustomerId may be null and would throw a NullReferenceException when used.
findings.suggestion: Guard with a null check and return a 400 response.

findings.title: Consider extracting magic string
findings.description: The literal 'pending' is used in multiple places in this file.
findings.suggestion: Define a const or enum for order statuses.
